proof_contract: First welfare: LNS makes weakly better bundles cost at least wealth, strictly better bundles more; profit ownership and balanced transfers make total value contradiction. No convexity required.

Second welfare: convex Xi in R_+^L, relative-continuous LNS weak orders with convex upper contours, convex nonempty Yj and free-disposal feasibility. Prove open/noncompact separation via closed convex projections and a boundary limit. Separate strict-improvement sums from interior resource set; extend to all resources, derive nonnegative nonzero price, slack complementarity, firm supports and consumer lower-cost bounds. Construct transfers from p.xstar minus endowment/profit wealth. Prove distinct cheaper-bundle upgrade via convex accessibility and relative continuity.

Aggregation iff common affine Engel slopes on a C1 product of open connected income intervals, at each fixed common price and n>=2. Proof uses balanced infinitesimal income transfers. Restricted one-total observations insufficient; no general integrability or normative representative utility claimed.

Finite Arrow for every weak-order profile on >=3 alternatives and finite nonempty voters, weak-order social outputs, unanimity for strict preferences and pairwise IIA. Almost-decisive pair propagates to every strongly decisive ordered pair using three-alternative profiles, including outsiders' ties. A smallest coalition splits into two smaller candidate coalitions; social weak/strict branches force one to be decisive, hence singleton dictator.
Odd-voter single-peaked median peak is a strict Condorcet winner by counting peaks at least/at most the median; no stronger strategy-proofness or agenda theorem asserted.

Positive weighted sums preserve Pareto improvements but depend on interpersonal scales; max-min needs a separate efficiency check. Complete resource-frontier optima via Cauchy–Schwarz and a max-min feasibility bound.
limits: Synthetic exact models; no national policy/legal/empirical claims.
Preference continuity is relative to consumption sets; no smooth interior substitute for separation.
Balanced value transfers presume the stated lump-sum authority and complete-market trading opportunities.
No general representative-consumer theorem, infinite-voter Arrow extension or strategic-voting theorem.
